title: onSuccessUpdateEmail response: oldState equals newState (both fetched after updates)
description: submission.rs:384-399 — email_old_state is fetched AFTER the update_object loop has already bumped the state. Both oldState and newState in the extra Email/set invocation are set to this post-update value, making them equal. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires oldState = state before the operation and newState = state after. Client delta-sync logic will break.
